editorial:
Imagine being a tough teenager with a hard home life and a mother who drinks too much. That is where you meet Min, a guy who looks like he has it all figured out but is actually struggling. You get to follow him from his wild high school days into a dangerous world of gangs and street fights. To make things even more intense, Min falls for Romi, a girl from a rich family who wants a bright future. The vibe is gritty and raw, making you feel the pressure of a kid trying to find his place while the world keeps pulling him down into the dirt.

You will love the raw energy of the fight scenes and how the movie captures that late-90s style. The acting feels real, and you can truly feel Min's pain as his life spirals. While some parts of the plot move a bit slow, the emotional payoff is worth it. If you love stories about loyalty and forbidden love, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the details clearly, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The story ends on a sad note. Min gets deeper into the gang life, but it only leads to more pain. After a brutal series of fights and betrayals, Min faces the harsh reality that he cannot escape his environment. He loses his chance at a normal life with Romi. The movie wraps up by showing that the cycle of violence only leads to loss, leaving you feeling empty and thoughtful about Min's choices.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school street fight movies and sad romances.
